title: AgentEvent
description: One lifecycle event of a coding agent, sent by the hook relay to the hub over the internal socket.

event.description: What happened. `Notification` is Claude's own event, which the hub maps onto the others.

devboxSession.description: `$DEVBOX_SESSION` of the agent's process, when the hub started it.

tmuxPane.description: `$TMUX_PANE` of the agent's process, when it runs in tmux.

ts.description: When the event happened (Unix time, ms).

payload.description: The agent's hook JSON as received; a string when it was not valid JSON.
